package fwprovider

import (
	"context"
	"encoding/json"
	"fmt"
	"net/http"
	"net/http/httptest"
	"sync/atomic"
	"testing"

	"github.com/DataDog/datadog-api-client-go/v2/api/datadog"
	"github.com/DataDog/datadog-api-client-go/v2/api/datadogV2"
	"github.com/hashicorp/terraform-plugin-framework/resource"
	"github.com/hashicorp/terraform-plugin-framework/tfsdk"
	"github.com/hashicorp/terraform-plugin-framework/types"
)

func TestTFGenUpdateOnlyInitialization(t *testing.T) {
	for _, tc := range []struct {
		name, returned string
		configured     types.String
		patches        int
		fail           bool
	}{
		{name: "omitted", configured: types.StringValue("requested"), patches: 1},
		{name: "different", configured: types.StringValue("requested"), returned: ",\"description\":\"server default\"", patches: 1},
		{name: "matching", configured: types.StringValue("requested"), returned: ",\"description\":\"requested\""},
		{name: "unconfigured", configured: types.StringNull()},
		{name: "unknown", configured: types.StringUnknown()},
		{name: "initialization error retains ID", configured: types.StringValue("requested"), patches: 1, fail: true},
	} {
		t.Run(tc.name, func(t *testing.T) {
			ctx := context.Background()
			var patches atomic.Int32
			server := httptest.NewServer(http.HandlerFunc(func(w http.ResponseWriter, req *http.Request) {
				w.Header().Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
				description := tc.returned
				if req.Method == http.MethodPatch {
					patches.Add(1)
					if req.URL.Path != "/api/v2/incidents/config/types/created-id" {
						t.Errorf("initialization path = %s", req.URL.Path)
					}
					var body struct {
						Data struct {
							ID         string         `json:"id"`
							Attributes map[string]any `json:"attributes"`
						} `json:"data"`
					}
					if err := json.NewDecoder(req.Body).Decode(&body); err != nil {
						t.Error(err)
					}
					if body.Data.ID != "created-id" || body.Data.Attributes["description"] != "requested" {
						t.Errorf("initialization body = %+v", body)
					}
					if tc.fail {
						w.WriteHeader(http.StatusBadRequest)
						fmt.Fprint(w, `{"errors":["initialization rejected"]}`)
						return
					}
					description = ",\"description\":\"requested\""
				} else if req.Method == http.MethodPost {
					var body struct {
						Data struct {
							Attributes map[string]any `json:"attributes"`
						} `json:"data"`
					}
					if err := json.NewDecoder(req.Body).Decode(&body); err != nil {
						t.Error(err)
					}
					if _, present := body.Data.Attributes["description"]; present {
						t.Error("Create sent the update-only description")
					}
					w.WriteHeader(http.StatusCreated)
				} else {
					t.Errorf("unexpected method %s", req.Method)
				}
				fmt.Fprintf(w, `{"data":{"id":"created-id","type":"incident_types","attributes":{"name":"fixture","is_default":false%s}}}`, description)
			}))
			defer server.Close()
			cfg := datadog.NewConfiguration()
			cfg.Servers = datadog.ServerConfigurations{{URL: server.URL}}
			cfg.OperationServers = nil
			cfg.HTTPClient = server.Client()
			cfg.SetUnstableOperationEnabled("v2.CreateIncidentType", true)
			cfg.SetUnstableOperationEnabled("v2.UpdateIncidentType", true)
			r := &datadogTfgenInitializationFixtureResource{Api: datadogV2.NewIncidentsApi(datadog.NewAPIClient(cfg)), Auth: ctx}
			var schemaResponse resource.SchemaResponse
			r.Schema(ctx, resource.SchemaRequest{}, &schemaResponse)
			model := resourceDatadogTfgenInitializationFixture_Model{
				ID: types.StringUnknown(), Name: types.StringValue("fixture"), Description: tc.configured, IsDefault: types.BoolValue(false),
			}
			plan := tfsdk.Plan{Schema: schemaResponse.Schema}
			if diags := plan.Set(ctx, &model); diags.HasError() {
				t.Fatal(diags)
			}
			response := resource.CreateResponse{State: tfsdk.State{Schema: schemaResponse.Schema}}
			r.Create(ctx, resource.CreateRequest{Plan: plan}, &response)
			if calls := patches.Load(); calls != int32(tc.patches) {
				t.Errorf("initialization PATCH calls = %d, want %d", calls, tc.patches)
			}
			if response.Diagnostics.HasError() != tc.fail {
				t.Fatalf("Create diagnostics: %v", response.Diagnostics)
			}
			var state resourceDatadogTfgenInitializationFixture_Model
			if diags := response.State.Get(ctx, &state); diags.HasError() {
				t.Fatal(diags)
			}
			if state.ID.ValueString() != "created-id" {
				t.Fatalf("created identity lost: %v", state.ID)
			}
			if !tc.fail && !tc.configured.IsNull() && !tc.configured.IsUnknown() && !state.Description.Equal(tc.configured) {
				t.Errorf("description = %v, want %v", state.Description, tc.configured)
			}
		})
	}
}
